t: This is the Minories, a street in the Aldgate area of the City. Both the street and the old administrative area around it take their name from the Abbey of the Minoresses of St. Clare without Aldgate. Two people are tied to it. Henry Brooke, Lord Cobham, an English peer implicated in the Main Plot against James the First, died here in 1619. William Winterbotham was born here in 1763. He became a Baptist minister, and in the 1790s was a political prisoner during the government's crackdown on dissent.
